rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE LADDERIZED INTERFACE BETWEEN TECHNICAL-VOCATIONAL EDUCATION AND TRAINING AND HIGHER EDUCATION
rows.title_short: Ladderized Education Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: \"Ladderized Education Act Of 2009.\" Seeks to strengthen the ladderized interface between Technical vocational Education and Training (TVET) and higher Education to achieve the following: 1) to open the pathways of opportunity for career and educational progression of students and workers; 2) to create a seamless and borderless education; 3) to empower students and workers to exercise options or to choose when to enter and exit from the educational ladder; 4) to create job platforms at every exit and the opportunity to earn income, and; to solve the problem of structural employment or skills and job mismatch.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2009-11-16, transmitted to on 2009-11-17 and received by the Senate on 2009-11-17

rows.title_short: Giving Offenders The Fullest Benefit Of Preventive Imprisonment
rows.abstract: Seeks to correct the  iniquitous application of the law where a person convicted of a bailable offense or is convicted of a bailable offense cannot afford bail, undergoes preventive imprisonment. rows.title_short: Providing For The Manner In Which An Acting President Shall Be Selected In Case The President, Vice-president, Senate President And Speaker Of The House Fails To Qualify Or Is Unable To Assume And Discharge The Functions Of The Office Of The President Of The Philippines
rows.abstract: Seeks to fulfill the Constitutional provision mandating Congress to enact a law to determine who will serve as Acting President in case the President, Vice-President, Senate President, Speaker of the House, fails to qualify or is unable to assume and discharge the functions of the Office of the President. This is apparently to prevent a vacuum in the Office of the President - a very dangerous situation that could lead to bloodshed and anarchy, and the very thought of which has adverse effects to the stability of the economy.

rows.abstract: Seeks to protect and enhance the right of all people to human dignity and reduce social inequities by alleviatinge the plight of poor convicts who are compelled to serve subsidiary imprisonment for the reason that they do not have the means to pay the fine imposed upon them whereby, the current rate of subsidiary imprisonment has not only become obsolete but also imposes an unreasonabe burden on poor convicts; considerably reduce the total number of days of subsidiary imprisonment that a prisoner would have to serve, and; effect jail decongestion by imposing penalty that is commensurate to the offense committeed by the convict.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2009-12-08, transmitted to on 2009-12-10 and received by the Senate on 2009-12-10

rows.title_short: Anti - Smuggling Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: Aims to protect government revenue derived from importations by infusing the Tariff and Customs Code of the Philippines, as amended, with certain provisions that will plug perceived loopholes and weaknesses in the Code which abet the commission of technical and outright smuggling; protect the domestic industries against unfair competition brough about by fraudulently imported articles which are generally and usually priced below the domestic market values of the comparative locally manufactured goods, and; upgrade manifold the penal provisions in the Code which have not been updated and amended since 1957 and are therefore already impotent in deterring the commission of smuggling.
